Decision to document: Define the problems, services, or decision types the PFAC is expected to inform
Evidence or source: Strategic priorities; safety priorities; experience/access signals; local needs assessment
Review trigger: Annual review or material scope change

Decision to document: Specify where PFAC input is advisory, where response is required, and where formal approval authority remains elsewhere
Evidence or source: Committee charters; governance map; policy workflow

Decision to document: Define how substantive projects reach the PFAC before final decisions are made
Evidence or source: Project intake process; annual work plan; safety and quality pipeline

Decision to document: Define who should be represented and how participation barriers will be identified and mitigated
Evidence or source: Local population context; current membership; access and participation data
Accountable role: PFAC staff lead with equity/access partner

Decision to document: Define orientation, training, accessibility, compensation or reimbursement, interpretation, and participation supports
Evidence or source: Local policy; member feedback; participation barriers

Decision to document: Require accepted, modified, deferred, or declined recommendations to have an owner and documented rationale
Evidence or source: Action tracker; meeting minutes; decision records

Decision to document: Define where unresolved safety, access, equity, or governance concerns move when they cannot be closed at the PFAC level
Evidence or source: Governance structure; safety escalation policy; executive pathways

Decision to document: Define structure, process, implementation, report-back, and project-specific measures
Evidence or source: PFAC measurement plan; project data sources

Decision to document: Define how patients and families will be told what changed, what did not, why, and what remains open
Accountable role: PFAC staff lead and decision owner
Review trigger: Each closed, deferred, or declined item

Decision to document: Set a cadence for reviewing whether governance remains fit for purpose
Evidence or source: PFAC performance signals; member feedback; organizational changes
